مُحَلَّلٌ : see مِحْلَالٌ. Also Any water at which camels have abode, and which they have consequently rendered turbid. (K.) ＝
-A2- مُحَلَّلٌ لَهُ A man whose remarriage to his wife whom he has trebly divorced has been made lawful to him by her having been married to, and divorced by, another man; (Mgh, * TA;) as also لَهُ ↓ مُحَلٌّ (Mgh) and لُهُ ↓ مَحْلُولٌ (TA) and ↓ حَالٌّ , (ElKarkhee, Mgh,) or this last signifies [properly] one whose wife is lawful to him. (TA.) ＝
-A3- مٌحًلَّلٌ also signifies A thing little in quantity. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
